def read_input():
    return int(input().strip())

def main():
    n = read_input()
    a = [read_input() for _ in range(n)]
    k = read_input()
    
    a.sort()
    
    ans = 1
    for i in range(n):
        cnt = 1
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if a[j] - a[i] <= k:
                cnt += 1
            else:
                break
        ans = max(ans, cnt)
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
